roqsim brand artwork -- original work authored for roqsim, licensed Apache-2.0 with the rest of
this repository. No third-party content.

  roqsim-horizontal-github.png       967 x 206    README header
  roqsim-transparent.png            1536 x 1024   docs sidebar logo (html_logo)
  roqsim-social-preview-1280x640.png 1280 x 640   GitHub repo social preview (uploaded via
                                                  Settings > General > Social preview; the file is
                                                  kept here so the source of that image is tracked)
  favicon.ico                        256 x 256    docs favicon (html_favicon)
  roqsim-favicon.png                 512 x 512    PNG favicon variant

These are presentation assets: they are NOT packaged into the wheel. Two images are loaded at
runtime and stay in the package on purpose:

  roqsim/src/roqsim/assets/splash.jpg   the viewer's loading overlay (roqsim/splash.py)
  roqsim/src/roqsim/assets/icon.png     the viewer's window icon (roqsim/window_branding.py),
                                        roqsim-favicon.png resampled to 256 x 256
